decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham fits the strategic expansion of organic lines in a growing industry, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results remain uncertain.
Organic Kasseler is close to the core range and supports the organic direction, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
Organic pepper salami is a low-risk extension of an established category that fits the organic strategy and can be carried using the firm's slack.
The exotic teriyaki aspic is more niche, and deli counters were under pressure after 2020, so a shortfall is plausible, but it is still likely kept as a seasonal or premium counter specialty.
Fennel salami got its own product page, signalling commitment, though flavour variants are often rotated if their sales fall below aspiration.
A classic liver pâté with veal sits squarely in the firm's established pâté range, so it likely meets aspirations with little reason to drop it.
